claims: `scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:601` — the focus guard leaks under `--no-lock`: the condition checks only `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD` and `GITHUB_ACTIONS`, so an exported `GATE_TEST_FOCUS` can shrink the gate's self-test

The comment above the guard, and `docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1143-1147`, claim `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD` is carried by "any command a real gate run spawns" so "an exported focus cannot shrink the gate's self-test" — that is not true; the doc bullet needs the same correction

With `--no-lock` or `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0`, `acquire_gate_run_lock` returns at `scripts/agent-quality-gate.sh:1616-1618` so it never reaches the only `export AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD` at `scripts/agent-quality-gate.sh:1143`, and the gate reports its self-test green after running one family out of eleven
Tabs in the focus list are not stripped (`${req// /}` only handles spaces)
The partition check only covers the region between the markers, so a test added to the prelude (before line 655) runs in *every* focused mode uncaught

`.claude/settings.json:31-32` allowlists `Bash(bash scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:*)`, which won't prefix-match the documented `GATE_TEST_FOCUS=… bash scripts/…` form — agents will hit a prompt on the invocation the doc tells them to use (and adding it means updating the pin in `scripts/context/check-settings-contract.mjs:74-75`)
